utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.text: Pia: It’s sounding promising so far—support is coming in. I’m mainly hoping the logistics stay manageable, so please let me know if you need extra hands or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Opal
